title: Pressing the Enter key on the "Session" button should open its context menu
line: Pressing Enter on a focused button, like the Session button in the Application Launcher, now presses it, just like Space.
explanation: Qt Quick buttons only react to the keys listed in the platform theme's ButtonPressKeys hint, and KDE's platform theme never set it, so only Qt's default Space worked. Kickoff's Restart and Shut Down buttons handle Return themselves, but the Session menu button doesn't, so Enter did nothing there (on master it even moved focus back to the first favourite). The change sets ButtonPressKeys to Space, Return, Enter and Select in KDE's platform theme, as plasma-integration MR !45 does.

commits.message:
KdePlatformTheme: Allow Space/Enter/Return/Select to press buttons

Qt Quick buttons only reacted to Space when they had keyboard focus, so
pressing Enter on a focused button such as Kickoff's Session menu did
nothing. Set the ButtonPressKeys hint so Enter, Return and Select work.

BUG: 519042

patches.diff:
From 15193ba62cfd655f0b81623cb98103d708d6db8e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 20:16:31 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] KdePlatformTheme: Allow Space/Enter/Return/Select to press
 buttons

Qt Quick buttons only reacted to Space when they had keyboard focus, so
pressing Enter on a focused button such as Kickoff's Session menu did
nothing. Set the ButtonPressKeys hint so Enter, Return and Select work.

BUG: 519042
---
 qt6/src/platformtheme/khintssettings.cpp | 2 ++
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)

diff --git a/qt6/src/platformtheme/khintssettings.cpp b/qt6/src/platformtheme/khintssettings.cpp
index 988ebae..fcff470 100644
--- a/qt6/src/platformtheme/khintssettings.cpp
+++ b/qt6/src/platformtheme/khintssettings.cpp
@@ -132,6 +132,8 @@ KHintsSettings::KHintsSettings(const KSharedConfig::Ptr &kdeglobals)
 
     m_hints[QPlatformTheme::ShowShortcutsInContextMenus] = true;
 
+    m_hints[QPlatformTheme::ButtonPressKeys] = QVariant::fromValue(QList<Qt::Key>({Qt::Key_Space, Qt::Key_Return, Qt::Key_Enter, Qt::Key_Select}));
+
     QMetaObject::invokeMethod(this, "delayedDBusConnects", Qt::QueuedConnection);
     QMetaObject::invokeMethod(this, "setupIconLoader", Qt::QueuedConnection);
 
--

media.caption: Before: after pressing Enter no menu opens and focus jumps back
After: pressing Enter opens the Session menu

review.text: Clean, idiomatic fix in plasma-integration using Qt's official QPlatformTheme::ButtonPressKeys hint, matching plasma-integration!45 and the maintainer guidance on the bug report. Before/after screenshots and regression checks confirm that pressing Enter on Kickoff's focused Session button opens its menu while preserving Space and existing Return handlers.

reviews.text: Clean, idiomatic fix in plasma-integration using Qt's official QPlatformTheme::ButtonPressKeys hint, matching plasma-integration!45 and the maintainer guidance on the bug report. Before/after screenshots and regression checks confirm that pressing Enter on Kickoff's focused Session button opens its menu while preserving Space and existing Return handlers.

Setting QPlatformTheme::ButtonPressKeys in KDE's platform theme is the approach Nate endorsed in c1, and it fixes the reported Session button (after-2 shows the menu opening on Enter). But it changes Return/Enter for every focused Qt Quick AbstractButton in every app, and verify only re-checked Kickoff's Leave buttons, which have their own Keys handlers. Focused AbstractButton-based delegates (e.g. Kickoff's T.ItemDelegate, which ListView focuses via focusCurrentItem) will now accept the Return press themselves, so the parent view's Keys.onPressed Return handling (Kickoff's launchMatchTimer logic, grid view activation) is bypassed and activation moves to key release. Also, before-1 and after-1 are identical shots that prove nothing.
changes: Regression-test the paths where a parent handles Return for a focused button-like child: in Kickoff, arrow into a list and a grid (favourites, apps, search results while the runner is still querying), press Enter and confirm the item launches exactly once and the search timing logic still works; adjust Kickoff if the view's handler is now bypassed in a harmful way

Check a Kirigami/QQC2 dialog with a default (accept) button while another button such as Cancel has focus, and a QML KCM in System Settings, to confirm Enter now does the expected thing and nothing triggers twice
Replace the identical before-1/after-1 pair with media that show the difference (e.g. before: Enter pressed, no menu; after: menu open)
